WNBA FRANCHISE COMPLETION REWARDS. Same three rules as the NBA set: the card wears that franchise's jersey (hard), it is an upgrade on that player's own base card (hard), and it is absent from THAT TEAM'S 2026 roster (preferred, exceptions declared). The band each franchise earns comes from collectionDifficulty.rewardBandFor, so a harder roster pays a better card. Salaries in the notes are from the shortlist batch; buildShootingLayer is batch-relative, so the built number moves a little and assertEarnedBands is what actually enforces the band.

RELOCATION AND LINEAGE. A relocated franchise's old seasons reward the team that carries them today -- Detroit and Tulsa Shock seasons reward Dallas, Utah Starzz and San Antonio Silver Stars reward Las Vegas, the Orlando Miracle rewards Connecticut. PORTLAND IS A NAME REVIVAL, NOT A RELOCATION, and it is here anyway: the 2026 Fire took the 2000-2002 Fire's name and city, the archive files both under POR, and the user's rule is that lineage counts. The Comets, Sting, Monarchs, Rockers and Sol are still excluded -- not out of rigidity but because Houston, Charlotte, Sacramento, Cleveland and Miami have no team for those seasons to be a reward FOR.

IND.name: Tamika Catchings
IND.note: Hardest collection in the league, so the top of the ladder. 2012 is the Fever's only title and her Finals MVP. ~$1810.

MIN.name: Seimone Augustus
MIN.note: Lynx franchise player, low in band so MIN sits under LVA. ~$1290.

NYL.name: Cappie Pondexter
NYL.note: Her first Liberty season. Tina Charles 2015 was the first pick and priced $1270 on SMOOTHED per-100 rates; her real game log put her at $880, well under the legendary floor. ~$1320. 2026-09-09: reprices $1190, $10 under the legendary floor; kept under the one-step tolerance rule (REWARD_BAND_TOLERANCE) because no eligible Liberty season reaches $1200 — Pondexter 2012 $960, McCarville 2008 $910, Prince 2015 $870.
NYL.bandException: Ten dollars under the legendary floor at $1190 after the 2026-09-09 reprice (absolute paint line + any-player-may-spend salary rule). No eligible Liberty season reaches $1200 on a real log: her 2012 $960, McCarville 2008 $910, Prince 2015 $870; Stewart and Ionescu are on the roster this reward is for, Charles is carded by name. The user, 2026-09-09: keep Pondexter, allow ten under. The same size of exception Las Vegas carries for Hammon and Philadelphia for Erving.

ATL.name: Angel McCoughtry
ATL.note: The Dream's defining player, in the season she set the Finals scoring record (38 in Game 2). ATL has crossed the band line THREE times as WNBA attributes changed: 2010 ($1270, legendary) -> 2018 ($1100 then $1010, super-rare) -> legendary again after the 0.88 league factor (2026-09-06). Her 2012 clears the new floor by $10, 2011 by $140, so 2011 holds it through a reprice. Expect to re-check after any WNBA rebuild. ~$1340.

DAL.name: Cheryl Ford
DAL.note: The Shock's 2006 title year, her second ring. Back as the pick after DAL returned to super-rare on 2026-09-09: $960 on her real log. Her 2008 ($730) was the pick while DAL earned rare; Cambage 2018 ($1440) and 2013 ($1300) price legendary; Cindy Brown 1998 ($860) sits under the floor.

CHI.name: Epiphanny Prince
CHI.note: Bottom of the super-rare band, so the cheapest of the four -- and since the 0.88 league factor (2026-09-06) thirty dollars under it. ~$870.
CHI.bandException: Thirty dollars under the super-rare floor at $870 after the 2026-09-06 league factor. Her 2012 ($1270) clears it into LEGENDARY, $70 over; no other eligible Sky season reaches $900 (Meesseman 2022 $830, Quigley 2017 $850; Vandersloot, Fowles and Parker are carded elsewhere). Under by thirty keeps the reward below the harder collections' rewards, which is what the band is for. The same size of exception Las Vegas gets for Hammon.

PHO.name: Penny Taylor
PHO.note: All-WNBA First Team at her peak, the Mercury's engine across both title eras. PHO's earned band rose to super-rare with the 0.88 league factor (2026-09-06) while Bonner 2014 fell to $700; Taylor's 2007 title season prices $1180, twenty dollars under the legendary line, so 2011 at $1040 holds the band through a reprice. Michele Timms 1997 was the first pick here and built to $900, one dollar over the old rare ceiling. ~$1040.

SEA.name: Alysha Clark
SEA.note: The bubble title, her second ring with the Storm and the defensive anchor of both. Sue Bird 2009 fell to $650 with the 0.88 league factor (2026-09-06), and Bird is a Super Season legend now. Camille Little 2010 ($700) sits on the floor; Clark holds the band mid-way and is off the roster (Las Vegas). ~$850.

POR.name: Sophia Witherspoon
POR.note: An original 2000 Fire player for the revived Fire -- and the only legal option Portland has. ~$630.
POR.bandException: Portland earns super-rare ($900-1199) since the 2026-09-06 league factor, but no Fire season prices above $730 (Tamicha Jackson 2002): the franchise played three seasons, 2000-02, and its best players were journeymen. The cheapest reward in the set, declared rather than hidden -- the same kind of exception Las Vegas gets for Hammon, in the other direction.

LAS.name: Mwadi Mabika
LAS.note: The Sparks' first title, from an All-Star who was there from 1997 and won both. Tamecka Dixon 1997 fell to $670 under the rare floor with the 0.88 league factor (2026-09-06); Mabika 2000 prices $890 at the ceiling, 2001 $800 mid-band. Nikki Teasley 2003 was the first pick and rebuilt to $690. ~$800.

CON.name: Nykesha Sales
CON.note: The Sun's defining early player, carried over from the Orlando Miracle. ~$840.

LVA.bandException: Ten dollars under the legendary floor at $1190. A migrated card is NOT repriced -- it keeps the salary its own set gave it -- so the alternative is un-migrating her and printing a second Becky Hammon a year apart, which is the duplicate the migration exists to prevent. The same size of exception Philadelphia gets for Erving.
LVA.note: Her 2009 Silver Stars season, moved rather than reprinted. Keeps its SUPER SEASON badge and gains TEAM REWARD. The WNBA Super Season set drops to 15.

_excluded.GSV: Golden State has ONE season of history (2025) and every in-band player from it is on the 2026 Valkyries roster. The ceiling is Veronica Burton at ~$1160 against a $1200 floor, and she is on the roster anyway. Stays a coins-only goal.
_excluded.TOR: The Tempo have no history at all. Every player on the roster is already in the base set. Stays a coins-only goal.
